learning_outcomes.text: Apply financial-modelling best practice: clear inputs, calculations and outputs separated
Build the three linked statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) that balance
Drive a model from documented assumptions and avoid hard-coded numbers in formulas
Build scenarios and sensitivities with data tables, scenario inputs and toggles
Use core finance functions NPV, IRR, PMT and XNPV correctly, mindful of their assumptions
Check and audit a model for integrity: balance checks, error flags and consistent signs

integrative_case: An analyst builds a three-statement model for a new product line: they separate inputs from calculations, link the statements so the balance sheet balances, add base/upside/downside scenario toggles and an NPV sensitivity table, and include balance checks before the model informs an investment decision.
